title.zh: 宣布每年 11 月 2 日为西米萨米斯省特别非工作假日（名称为Araw Ng Misamis Occidental），以纪念Founding周年纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring November 2 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Misamis Occidental, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary, to Be Known as Araw Ng Misamis Occidental
title.orig: An Act Declaring November 2 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Misamis Occidental, in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary, to Be Known as Araw Ng Misamis Occidental
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 2 tháng 11 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Misamis Occidental với tên gọi "Araw Ng Misamis Occidental", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 2 พฤศจิกายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในจังหวัด Misamis Occidental ในชื่อ "Araw Ng Misamis Occidental" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 2 November setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Provinsi Misamis Occidental dengan nama "Araw Ng Misamis Occidental", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 2 November setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Wilayah Misamis Occidental dengan nama "Araw Ng Misamis Occidental", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11121_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: November 2 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Misamis Occidental, in commemoration of its founding anniversary, to be known as "Araw ng Misamis Occidental".
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
